claims.scope: _matchIncomingOrder quote-denominated fill order matching with lot-size flooring

preconditions.text: The incoming fill order is quote-denominated (amountIsBase = false).; A lot-size constraint is present so that lot-size flooring can reduce the tradeable base amount.; The incoming order has a remaining quote amount (example: remaining taker.amount = 2.5e18).; Maker base liquidity is available to match (example: maker base = 3e18).; The order is a Fill-or-Kill order subject to FOK validation.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。
evidence: This bug exists in the `_matchIncomingOrder` [function](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-07-gte-clob/blob/9f06332ebd4cfe2577d9eae81aeb58d3662ffccd/contracts/clob/CLOB.sol#L823-L827) in `CLOB.sol` where quote-denominated fill orders (`amountIsBase: false`) incorrectly track remaining amounts when lot-size flooring occurs.
- `amountIsBase = false`

When `baseDelta != matchedBase` (which happens when lot-size flooring reduces the tradeable amount), the system incorrectly sets `matchedAmount = takerOrder.amount` (the full remaining quote amount) instead of `quoteDelta` (the actual quote amount consumed).
- `lotSizeInBase = 1e18`
This bug affects all quote-denominated fill orders when lot-size constraints are present, which is a core feature as evidenced by test coverage in .
- `remaining taker.amount = 2.5e18` (2.5 quote units)
- `maker base = 3e18`
For Fill-or-Kill orders, this creates a critical failure mode. The FOK validation check

safety.text: A Fill-or-Kill order must either execute completely or fail entirely; it must not be marked fully filled while any amount remains unfilled.; The incoming order's remaining amount must be decremented by the actual quote amount consumed (quoteDelta), not the full remaining quote amount.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。
evidence: This check passes because `newOrder.amount` has been incorrectly reduced to 0, even though dust quote amount remains unfilled. This violates the FOK guarantee that orders either execute completely or fail entirely.

When `baseDelta != matchedBase` (which happens when lot-size flooring reduces the tradeable amount), the system incorrectly sets `matchedAmount = takerOrder.amount` (the full remaining quote amount) instead of `quoteDelta` (the actual quote amount consumed).

The incorrect `matchedAmount` is used to decrement the incoming order's remaining amount in both [bid](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-07-gte-clob/blob/9f06332ebd4cfe2577d9eae81aeb58d3662ffccd/contracts/clob/CLOB.sol#L763) and [ask](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-07-gte-clob/blob/9f06332ebd4cfe2577d9eae81aeb58d3662ffccd/contracts/clob/CLOB.sol#L797) matching loops. This over-subtraction causes the matching loop to terminate prematurely, preventing the order from continuing to match against additional liquidity.

effects.text: Users receive fewer base tokens than their quote amount should purchase.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。
evidence: Users receive fewer base tokens than their quote amount should purchase. Settlement uses the correct (smaller) `quoteDelta` and `baseDelta` values, but the user's order is marked as fully filled despite only partial execution.
